verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/mosh terminal client with no service API of its own, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is outside its product category. Its SSH key generation and ssh-agent support are general-purpose client keys, not scoped agent API credentials, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability. The 404 OpenAPI probe is consistent with there being no API to scope credentials for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
